name: KCM
description: The CoPrint KCM (Klipper Chroma Module) is a commercial multi-extruder control module for Klipper-based printers. Each color lane has a dedicated CX-I extruder with a NEMA 17 stepper motor and dual-drive gear mechanism. These extruders work in sync with the direct-drive extruder inside the ChromaHead toolhead. During a filament change, the active filament is cut and retracted only to the 8-in-1 module (not back to the spool), and the next filament is loaded through this short path. Expandable to 20 colors via ECM (Extended Chroma Module) add-ons.
features: Dedicated CX-I dual-drive extruder per lane
Short retraction path (to 8-in-1 module, not spool)
Controllable Purge System (claims 90% purge tower reduction)
ChromaHead modular toolhead with Input Shaper support
Expandable to 20 colors via ECM modules (up to 4 ECMs)
Compatible with many Klipper printers (Ender 3 V3, Creality K1, Voron, etc.)
KCM Set includes: module, ChromaHead, 8-in-1 module, 4x CX-I extruder kits
